entries.zh: 会合、相聚；相商议定（合意）
entries.en: to come together, meet; to agree or concert (settle jointly)
entries.notes: 首字[疑:找/抓]待考；音写 gîy-hūe 末字为「會」，据西语 juntarse/concertarse 取「会聚商定」义

entries.zh: 扫粪：把秽物垃圾扫拢堆积
entries.en: to sweep up refuse (basure, 17c spelling of basura) and heap it together
entries.notes: 第三字[疑:叫/叩]待考，不影响主干义；依「掃糞」与西语 bosura（垃圾）定

entries.en: to join or fasten together; to fit or adjust
entries.notes: 第二字[疑:扣/描]待考；依「搭」+西语 ajustar（配准、接合）取拼合义

entries.zh: 相与而立，聚合同心（协同一致）
entries.en: to join together in concord, to stand as one
entries.notes: 首字[疑:兩/西]待考，且第二音节声调记号 T99 污损难辨；释义系据西语 juntarse en concierto 推定

entries.zh: 相共：彼此相合，同处一处（相与一致）
entries.en: to be together, share in common; to conform with one another

entries.zh: 动兵：调集兵员人马（兴兵聚众）
entries.en: to muster troops and men, to raise soldiers

entries.zh: 头甲尾：把头与尾连缀起来（首尾相接）
entries.en: to join head and tail (fasten end to end)
to gather riches, to amass wealth

entries.zh: 那……那……：恶行越积越多，越来越坏
entries.en: to pile up evil upon evil, to grow worse and worse

entries.zh: 积少成多：积聚零星而成众多
entries.en: to gather little by little until it becomes much (many a little makes a mickle)
to accumulate and store up, to save up

entries.zh: 积粮草：筹聚军需给养（粮秣与接济）
entries.en: to gather provisions and relief supplies (military victuals and pay)
entries.notes: 西语 soldadτ 缩写未展开（疑为 soldada 兵饷或 soldados 兵员），义项主要依「積糧草」与 socorro（接济）定

entries.zh: 相合：彼此相合、会合为一
entries.en: to come together, to join or agree with one another

entries.zh: 合掌：双手合十（行礼祈祷状）
entries.en: to join the palms together, to press the hands (as in prayer)
